rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015and in furtherance to our intimation dated August 05, 2025, this is to inform you that the Companyhas today i.e. on July 27, 2026, entered into the following Amendment Agreements:1) Power Supply and Offtake Amendment Agreement with Pro-Zeal Green Power Eleven PrivateLimited ( SPV ) for supply of 3.30 MW captive hybrid - wind & solar power at the Company sSurat Unit, in addition to the supply of 6.60 MW captive hybrid - wind & solar power, underthe original Power Supply and Offtake Agreement with SPV;2) Investment and Shareholders' Amendment Agreement with Prozeal Green Power PrivateLimited ( PGPPL ) and SPV, for investment by the Company for an amount not exceeding ₹3.63crores by way of Compulsory Convertible Debentures in the SPV representing 26%, in one ormore tranches (and balance 74% investment will be made by PGPPL), to secure the additionalsupply as mentioned above. This will be in addition to the investment by the Company for anamount upto ₹6.60 crores, under the original Investment and Shareholders' Agreement.The above arrangement will facilitate significant savings on power costs of the Company whilstprogressing the Company s sustainability initiatives. In this regard, please find enclosed Annexure A.This intimation is also being made available on the Company s website www.nfil.in.
